ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הֵבִיא אֶת בָּנָיו לְבַקֵּר אֶת סָבָם הַחוֹלֶה.
ideas.children_en: Jacob is very sick. Joseph heard and brought his two sons to see their father. Jacob got ready to meet Joseph and talk, even though they didn’t meet much before.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב רָצָה שֶׁגַּם אֶפְרַיִם וּמְנַשֶּׁה יִהְיוּ חֵלֶק חָשׁוּב מִמִּשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob talks about God’s blessing he got in Canaan. He adopted Ephraim and Manasseh as his first sons to give them special status. Rachel died on the way and is buried in a special place.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב חִבֵּק אֶת נְכָדָיו וְשָׂמַח לִרְאוֹת אוֹתָם.
ideas.children_en: Jacob did not recognize his grandsons at first. Joseph said they are his sons. Jacob hugged them and got strong before blessing. Joseph bowed to his father to get ready for the blessing.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב בֵּרַךְ אֶת שְׁנֵי הַנְּכָדִים בְּאַהֲבָה.
ideas.children_en: Joseph placed young Ephraim on the left and older Manasseh on the right, but Jacob crossed his hands to bless Ephraim first. He asked God to bless the boys and that they grow many and continue his name.

ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים הַצָּעִיר מְקַבֵּל תַּפְקִיד גָּדוֹל יוֹתֵר מִן הַבְּכוֹר.
ideas.children_en: Joseph wanted the blessing on the older son, but Jacob refused. He knew Ephraim would be greater. He blessed both and said Israel will bless them with the younger above the older.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִבִּיט אֶל הֶעָתִיד וְרָצָה לְהַשְׁאִיר לְמִשְׁפַּחְתּוֹ תִּקְוָה.
ideas.children_en: Jacob says he will die soon and Joseph and his sons won’t return by themselves. But God will keep and bring them back. He gives Joseph two tribes as part of the inheritance.
